backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the media sharing platform, implementing video/photo storage, comments, likes, ratings, subscriptions, ad revenue tracking, and integrations with Stripe, Razorpay, and AdSense, with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping the DataRestorationBanner feature to its implementation files (Home.tsx, VideoGallery.tsx, DataRestorationBanner.tsx) with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, describing their purpose and key implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes including background, foreground, primary, sidebar, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Media Share app, setting metadata, favicon, Open Graph tags, and mounting the React app via /src/main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router route tree for all app pages (Home, VideoGallery, VideoPlayer, Settings, ChannelProfile, Upgrade, etc.) and wraps them in the Layout component.
frontend/src/components/AddToPlaylistMod: Empty file with no content, likely a placeholder for a future Add to Playlist modal component.
frontend/src/components/AdRevenueDashboa: Dashboard component showing a creator's total ad earnings, number of monetized videos, CPM rate, and a per-video revenue breakdown table using data from ad revenue hooks.
frontend/src/components/AdSenseScript.ts: Injects the Google AdSense script tag into the document head when a publisher ID is configured, and removes it on cleanup.
frontend/src/components/AdSenseUnit.tsx: Renders a single Google AdSense ad unit (`<ins>` tag) for a given ad slot, initializing adsbygoogle once the publisher ID is available.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Thin wrapper component that renders the ProfileDropdownMenu for placement in the app header.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with links to Home, Upload, Shorts, and Subscriptions, plus a Profile tab that opens a dropdown menu, with active state indicators.
frontend/src/components/ChannelNameDispl: Displays a channel name as a clickable link to the channel page, fetching the name via a hook and showing a skeleton loader or truncated principal while loading.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Renders a comment section for a video with a form to post new comments (for authenticated users) and a list of existing comments with author, timestamp, and content.
frontend/src/components/DataRestorationB: Displays a dismissible amber alert banner informing users that video restoration is in progress after a technical issue, persisting dismissal state in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/DeleteVideoButto: Renders a delete button that triggers a confirmation dialog before permanently deleting a video using the useDeleteVideo hook.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Provides the main app layout with a sticky header (logo, search, auth/upload buttons), a collapsible sidebar, bottom navigation, AdSense integration, and a footer.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCard.tsx: Displays a photo card with a thumbnail, title, uploader channel name, and upload time, linking to the individual photo page.
frontend/src/components/ProfileDropdownM: Renders a profile dropdown menu supporting multi-account management, showing the active account avatar/initials, account switching, sign-in/sign-out actions, and navigation to profile/settings pages.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that appears for authenticated users without a profile, prompting them to enter a name and optional channel name, then saves the profile via mutation.
frontend/src/components/RazorpaySetupMod: A modal dialog for entering and saving Razorpay API credentials (Key ID and Key Secret) to enable INR payments.
frontend/src/components/ShareButton.tsx: A button component that copies the current page URL to the clipboard and shows a toast notification on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: A responsive sidebar navigation component with Home, Trending, and Library links, supporting mobile overlay and close behavior.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetupModal: A modal dialog for configuring Stripe payments by entering a secret key and allowed countries, then saving the configuration via mutation.
frontend/src/components/TagInput.tsx: An input component that allows users to add and remove tags by pressing Enter or comma, displaying them as removable badges.
frontend/src/components/ThumbnailSelecto: A component for managing video thumbnails, supporting file upload, frame capture from a video element, and thumbnail removal with upload progress display.
frontend/src/components/UpgradePrompt.ts: A card component that displays a premium upgrade prompt with benefits and a navigation button, hidden for premium or unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Renders a video card component in either 'default' (full card with border) or 'compact' (horizontal thumbnail + info) layout, displaying thumbnail, title, channel name, view count, and upload time.
frontend/src/components/VideoEditModal.t: A dialog modal for editing video metadata (title, description, tags) and thumbnail, using tabs to separate details from settings, with save/cancel actions.
frontend/src/components/VideoQualitySele: A dropdown UI component for selecting video quality (auto, 360p–1080p) with local state; currently cosmetic with no actual stream switching.
frontend/src/components/VideoRating.tsx: Interactive 5-star rating widget that fetches the current user's rating and submits new ratings via hooks, requiring authentication to rate.
frontend/src/components/VideoRatingDispl: Read-only star rating display showing average rating with full/half/empty stars and total rating count fetched from backend hooks.
frontend/src/components/VideoSettings.ts: Thin wrapper component that renders the ThumbnailSelector for a given video within a settings panel.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddComment.ts: Mutation hook that posts a comment to a video via the actor and invalidates related query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdSenseConfig.ts: Provides hooks to get and set the AdSense publisher ID via the backend actor, with toast notifications on success or error.
frontend/src/hooks/useAverageRating.ts: Query hook that fetches the average star rating for a given video from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useChannelName.ts: Query hook that retrieves a channel's display name by principal from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useComments.ts: Query hook that fetches the list of comments for a given video from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Mutation hook that creates a Stripe checkout session via the backend actor, returning the session ID and redirect URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteVideo.ts: Mutation hook that deletes a video by ID via the actor, invalidates video caches, and shows appropriate success or error toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAdRevenueForCal: Query hook that fetches the total ad revenue earned by the currently authenticated caller from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAdRevenueForVid: Query hook that fetches ad revenue data (impressions and total revenue) for a specific video from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the current authenticated user's profile from the backend actor, with loading state tied to actor availability.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserRating.ts: React Query hook that retrieves the current user's rating for a specific video by fetching all user ratings and filtering by videoId.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserSubscriptio: React Query hook that fetches the user's subscription status and returns a normalized object indicating tier and upload permissions.
frontend/src/hooks/useIncrementVideoView: Mutation hook that calls the backend to increment a video's view count and invalidates related video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook for managing Internet Computer authentication via AuthClient, including login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarkThumbnailGener: Mutation hook that saves a generated thumbnail blob for a video on the backend and invalidates video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useMultiAccount.ts: Hook that manages multiple stored Internet Identity accounts in localStorage, supporting adding, removing, switching, and updating account display names.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhoto.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single photo by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotos.ts: React Query hook that fetches the list of all photo metadata from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoUpload.ts: Mutation hook that uploads a photo file to the backend as a Uint8Array, tracking upload progress and showing toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useRateVideo.ts: Mutation hook that submits a star rating for a video and invalidates rating-related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpayCheckout.t: Mutation hook that dynamically loads the Razorpay SDK, creates a payment order via the backend, opens the Razorpay checkout modal, and verifies the payment on completion.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpayConfig.ts: Provides hooks to check if Razorpay is configured and to set Razorpay API credentials via backend mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useRecordAdImpression: Mutation hook that records an ad impression for a video on the backend and invalidates ad revenue queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useRemoveThumbnail.ts: Mutation hook that removes a video's thumbnail via the backend and invalidates video queries, with error handling for unauthorized access.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: Mutation hook that saves the current user's profile to the backend and invalidates profile and channel name queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchVideos.ts: React Query hook that searches videos by a search term using the backend actor's `searchVideos` and `getVideo` methods, returning an array of `ExtendedVideo`.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetChannelName.ts: React Query mutation hook that calls the backend `setChannelName` method with validation, invalidates related queries, and shows toast notifications on success or error.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetCustomThumbnail: Mutation hook that uploads a custom thumbnail image for a video via `ExternalBlob`, tracks upload progress, and invalidates video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetSubscriptionSta: Mutation hook that calls the backend `setSubscriptionStatus` for a given user principal and invalidates the subscription status query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useStripeConfig.ts: Provides two hooks: `useIsStripeConfigured` queries whether Stripe is configured, and `useSetStripeConfiguration` is a mutation to save a Stripe configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscribe.ts: Mutation hook for subscribing to a channel; currently throws a placeholder error indicating the subscription feature is not yet implemented in the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionStatus: Query hook that returns a user's subscription status for a given channel principal; currently returns `false` as a placeholder until backend support is added.
frontend/src/hooks/useTotalRatings.ts: Query hook that fetches the total ratings count for a given video ID from the backend `getTotalRatings` method.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateVideo.ts: Mutation hook that calls the backend `updateVideo` method with title, description, and tags, then invalidates video queries and shows toast feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpgradeAccount.ts: Mutation hook for upgrading a user account to premium; currently simulates a delay and throws a not-implemented error as a placeholder.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserStats.ts: Query hook that fetches user statistics (video/photo counts, account creation time) for a given principal from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideo.ts: Query hook that fetches a single `ExtendedVideo` by video ID using the backend `getVideo` method.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoLike.ts: Mutation hook that calls the backend `likeVideo` method for a video ID and invalidates related video queries, showing error toasts on failure.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideos.ts: Query hook that fetches the full list of video metadata from the backend `listVideos` method.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoUpload.ts: Mutation hook that uploads a video file via `ExternalBlob` with progress tracking, calls the backend `uploadVideo`, and invalidates the videos list query on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/src/lib/types.ts: Defines shared TypeScript interfaces for frontend use, including `VideoMetadata`, `ExtendedVideo`, `Photo`, `Comment`, `UserStats`, and `SubscriptionStatus`.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/ChannelProfile.tsx: Page component that displays a channel's profile header (name, stats, banner) and lists the channel's uploaded videos, with edit and delete controls for the channel owner.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that fetches and displays all videos sorted by upload time (newest first) in a responsive grid, with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment cancellation/failure page that informs the user no charges were made and provides buttons to retry or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page that verifies a Stripe session by ID, invalidates subscription queries on success, and displays loading, success, or error states accordingly.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoGallery.tsx: Photo gallery page with debounced search filtering, displaying photos in a responsive grid with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoViewer.tsx: Single photo viewer page that fetches a photo by ID, converts its binary data to a blob URL for display, and shows metadata including uploader and upload date.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page showing the authenticated user's uploaded videos and photos in tabs, with edit/delete controls and an ad revenue dashboard; redirects unauthenticated users to sign in.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page allowing authenticated users to update their profile, manage subscription status, configure Stripe/Razorpay payment gateways, and set an AdSense publisher ID.
frontend/src/pages/Shorts.tsx: Placeholder page indicating that short-form video functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/Subscriptions.tsx: Displays a placeholder Subscriptions page that shows a 'Coming Soon' message for authenticated users or a prompt to browse channels for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/Upgrade.tsx: Renders a premium upgrade page with free vs. premium feature comparison, supporting both Stripe and Razorpay checkout flows with setup modals if payment providers are not yet configured.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPhoto.tsx: Provides a photo upload form with title, description, and file selection fields, showing upload progress and a success screen upon completion, gated behind authentication.
frontend/src/pages/UploadVideo.tsx: Provides a video upload form with title, description, tags, and file validation (format and size), and after a successful upload allows the user to select a thumbnail via ThumbnailSelector.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGallery.tsx: Displays a searchable grid of videos, debouncing the search input and switching between all-videos and search-results queries accordingly.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayer.tsx: Full video player page that tracks watch time to increment view counts and record ad impressions, and displays video metadata, likes, comments, related videos, and owner edit/delete controls.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Exports two utility functions: formatViewCount converts a BigInt view count to a human-readable string (K/M/B), and formatTimeAgo converts a nanosecond BigInt timestamp to a relative time string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those parameters via sessionStorage and history.replaceState.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that sets up dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, Inter font family, accordion keyframe animations, and enables the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a fix request to restore video data lost after deploying Version 35, with two pending action requests covering backend stable-variable preservation and migration.mo upgrade logic auditing.
